{{Top|leg}}
'''Opak Trolish''' was a [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Natori Association]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

As a [[mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], Trolish was a talented [[soldier/Legends|soldier]] and the [[squad/Legends|squads]] he led, even into daring frontal assaults, were successful. His talent, as well as his affinity to ambushes and stealth, ensured that he had outlived most of his peers, and was one of the most longeval sergeants of the Association.

He was stationed at [[Vergesso Base]] under the command of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Vam Margan]]. When not on duty, Trolish liked drinking and brawling in the [[cantina/Legends|cantina]]s of [[The Life]].
